parameters.name: ListenerIds
parameters.description: The listener IDs. You can specify at most 20 listener IDs.

parameters.name: LoadBalancerIds
parameters.description: The GWLB instance IDs. You can specify at most 20 instance IDs.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to be returned from a single query when the NextToken parameter is used in the query. Valid values: 1 to 1000. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description:
The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. Valid values:

*   If **NextToken** is empty, no next page exists.
*   If a value of **NextToken** is returned, the value indicates the token that is used for the next query.

parameters.name: Skip
parameters.description: The number of entries to be skipped in the call.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. You can specify at most 20 tags in each call.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gwlb list-listeners --listener-ids lsn-w3t3vpgjj12b2i0000 --load-balancer-ids gwlb-rbtjolkkbudmrr0000 --next-token d209f4e63ec942c967c50c888a130000 --max-results 20 --tag Value=tagValue Key=tagKey --skip 10 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun gwlb ListListeners --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key tagKey --NextToken d209f4e63ec942c967c50c888a130000 --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value tagValue --LoadBalancerIds.1 'gwlb-rbtjolkkbudmrr0000' --Skip 10 --ListenerIds.1 'lsn-w3t3vpgjj12b2i0000' --method POST --force
